name: Bolt.new
bestFor: Spiking a front-end in the browser with WebContainers
skipIf: You need native mobile or a long-lived backend
keyFeatures: Runs real Node.js in-browser via WebContainers
limitations: Token burn spikes during debugging loops
Not suited for native mobile or heavy backend services
summary: StackBlitz’s agentic browser builder. Fast demos. Token meters bite.
body: Bolt runs a real Node environment in the browser, which is still a magic trick. It is the right tab for a Friday spike. It is the wrong tab for a bank integration. Token and message limits are the business model. We verified the public marketing site on 17 Sep 2026.
notes: Download the project before you close the laptop
Compare with v0 if the output should be Next.js UI only
